description: Assign labels to short texts; output is a JSON array of labels.

tests.prompt:
Classify the sentiment of each review as exactly one of: positive, negative, neutral. Output only a JSON array of four strings, in order.
1. Absolutely loved it, will buy again!
2. Arrived broken and support never replied.
3. It works. Nothing special.
4. Not worth the price, I am returning it.

Classify each support ticket as exactly one of: billing, technical, account, other. Output only a JSON array of four strings, in order.
1. I was charged twice this month.
2. The app crashes when I open settings.
3. How do I change the email address on my profile?
4. Do you sell gift cards?
